reviews.title: Strong 1080p performance in a compact, quiet design
reviews.comment: I've been using the RTX 4060 Ti Founders Edition for about a month and it’s handled everything I’ve thrown at it. The design is sleek and compact, which made installation easy in my mid-size case. Cooling is efficient and quiet, even when gaming for hours. At 1080p, it crushes most modern games at high or ultra settings with high frame rates. It also holds up well at 1440p if you turn on DLSS. Frame generation helps smooth out performance in more demanding titles, and ray tracing is usable if you’re smart with your settings. My only real complaint is the 8 GB of VRAM. Some newer titles start to push that limit, so it’s worth keeping in mind depending on the games you play. Still, for the price and power usage, it delivers a lot of value. If you want a no-fuss card that delivers great results for esports and AAA games, this one gets the job done.
reviews.author: pattylabelle
